title: Hazardous Location
headline: Replaces up to 400W HID.
intro: Hazardous location fixtures are expensive, retrofitting them w/ UL approved lamps is NOT. Three wattages to choose from. Available in 5000K and 5700K for brighter, safer environments.

extras.title: Accessories on this page
extras.text: Two 10kA parallel surge arrestors (SPD-277P-10KA-EC-1 for 120-277V, SPD-347P-10KA for 120-347V) and three 480/347V-in / 240V-out step-down transformers (450VA/400W, 160VA/140W, 50VA/45W) are listed under the hazardous location lamps; see the Surge Arrestors and Step-Down Transformers tables.
